<h1 id="Michigan-Crop-Water-Atlas-%E2%80%94-100-Stations,-80-Years">Michigan Crop Water Atlas — 100 Stations, 80 Years<a class="anchor-link" href="#Michigan-Crop-Water-Atlas-%E2%80%94-100-Stations,-80-Years">¶</a></h1><p><strong>Citation / data:</strong> ERA5-derived daily weather courtesy of Open-Meteo hourly archive; methodological footprint described in airSpring Experiment 018 README.</p>
<p>This is the flagship integration experiment combining FAO-56 reference evaporation, staged crop coefficients, soil-water stress, MAD-style replenishment irrigation, and Stewart-type yield bookkeeping.</p>
<p><strong>AirSpring linkage:</strong> primal <code>ecology.full_pipeline</code>; Rust validator <code>validate_atlas</code>.</p>
<p>Baseline driver: <code>control/atlas/atlas_water_budget.py</code> — benchmark snapshot: <code>control/atlas/benchmark_atlas.json</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="Theory">Theory<a class="anchor-link" href="#Theory">¶</a></h2><p>Atlas processing threads together:</p>
<p>$$\mathrm{ET_0}=f_{\mathrm{PM}}\left(R_n,u_2,e_s-e_a,\Delta,\gamma\right)\quad\text{(FAO-56 Penman-Monteith)}$$</p>
<p>$$ET_{\mathrm{c},i}=K_{\mathrm{c},i}(t)\ ET_{0,i}, \quad ET_{\mathrm{a},i}=K_{\mathrm{s},i} ET_{\mathrm{c},i}$$
with $K_{\mathrm{c}}$ evolving through empirical initial/mid/end plateaus over the simulated season fraction, identical to Chapter 8 stress reduction with managed irrigation pulses when depletion crosses $RAW=p\,T_{\mathrm{AW}}$.</p>
<p>$$\frac{Y_a}{Y_m} = \max\left(0, \min\left(1, 1 - K_y (1 - \mathrm{ETA}/\mathrm{ETC})\right)\right)$$</p>
<p>where seasonal $\mathrm{ETA}/\mathrm{ETC}$ is accumulated actual vs unstressed totals.</p>
<p>The Python atlas script parses Open-Meteo CSV exports, restricts to agronomic summers (approximately DOY $121\le d \le 273$ when valid), and summarizes per crop means for cross-validation.</p>
